---
title: "scATAC Motif Enrichment"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Run motif enrichment and chromVAR-style motif activity storage in a Signac object.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/signac_integrated.qs"
motif_database <- "path/to/motif_database.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/signac_motifs.qs"
results_dir <- "results/motif_enrichment"
figures_dir <- "figures/motif_enrichment"
assay_name <- "peaks"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
ident_column <- "seurat_clusters"
condition_1 <- "condition_1"
condition_2 <- "condition_2"
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
motifs <- qs2::qs_read(file = motif_database, nthreads = n_threads)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column, ident_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(cells = ncol(object), peaks = nrow(object)), file.path(results_dir, "motif_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
object <- AddMotifs(object = object, genome = NULL, pfm = motifs)
Idents(object) <- object[[group_column, drop = TRUE]]
markers <- FindMarkers(object, ident.1 = condition_1, ident.2 = condition_2, only.pos = TRUE)
motif_enrichment <- FindMotifs(object, features = rownames(markers))
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(marker_peaks = nrow(markers), enriched_motifs = nrow(motif_enrichment)), file.path(results_dir, "motif_qc_summary.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "motif_region_stats.pdf"), width = 7, height = 4)
print(RegionStats(object))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$motif_enrichment <- list(condition_1 = condition_1, condition_2 = condition_2, n_motifs = nrow(motif_enrichment))
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::as_tibble(motif_enrichment), file.path(results_dir, "motif_enrichment.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scatac-03-motif-enrichment-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, enriched_motifs = nrow(motif_enrichment))
```
